about.title: About Me
about.intro: Hi! I'm Diego, a passionate Senior Full Stack Developer currently working at INDRA, where I design and build scalable web solutions that solve real-world problems.
about.description1: With over 3 years of professional experience, I specialize in creating modern, performant web applications using technologies like React, Node.js, and Angular. My journey has taken me from developing AI-powered platforms at Deliryum.AI to architecting enterprise-level solutions at INDRA.
about.description2: I'm driven by clean code, user-centric design, and continuous learning. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or sharing knowledge with the developer community.

indra.li1: Built and maintained enterprise platforms for ENEL, Codelco, and Chile's National Electrical Coordinator (CEN).
indra.li2: Engineered critical energy management and industrial monitoring systems for large-scale operations.
indra.li3: Migrated databases from Oracle to PostgreSQL and modernized legacy APIs with ASP.NET Core 9.
indra.li4: Architected solutions using Clean Architecture, CQRS, and Mediator patterns to enhance scalability and maintainability.
indra.li5: Developed full-stack applications with Angular and PHP for enterprise clients.

deliryum.li1: Built AI-powered video analytics solutions using YOLO and PyTorch for object detection and tracking.
deliryum.li2: Developed scalable REST APIs with Flask, FastAPI, and Django for production environments.
deliryum.li3: Created modern React applications consuming REST APIs with real-time data visualization.
deliryum.li4: Led technical coordination and mentored development team members.
deliryum.li5: Automated internal workflows and integrated database systems for improved efficiency.
deliryum.li6: Implemented computer vision algorithms for image analysis and pattern recognition.
